description: This project's features as its users meet them. Change Loop seeds this file once and never rewrites it. Add one entry per feature: { "id": "kebab-case", "name": "...", "summary": "what the user sees or does", "paths": ["src/feature/**"], "tests": [...], "docs": [...] }. Investigation and change intake read it, 'cloop features' checks it, and the approval page lists the features a change touches.
